entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: Legendary Phyrexian angel horror from New Phyrexia, compleated from a Mirran angel and called the Grand Unifier.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Praetor who honored Atraxa with compleation and sent her to New Capenna.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: Praetor who declined to join compleating Atraxa.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Praetor who joined Elesh Norn's compleation of Atraxa.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Praetor who joined Elesh Norn's compleation of Atraxa.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: Praetor who joined Elesh Norn's compleation of Atraxa.

entities.name: Ixhel
entities.description: Phyrexian angel made in Atraxa's visage.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: Plane where Atraxa led the Machine Legion.

entities.name: Machine Legion
entities.description: Phyrexian force Atraxa led against the Capennans.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: Magic whose effect harms Phyrexians on New Capenna.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker Atraxa's mission aimed to strike a blow against.

events.summary: Atraxa, a Mirran angel, is captured protecting a Mirran retreat.
events.quote: Atraxa was captured while single-handedly protecting a Mirran retreat

events.summary: Elesh Norn, with Jin-Gitaxias, Sheoldred and Vorinclex, compleats Atraxa while Urabrask declines.
events.quote: Jin-Gitaxias , Sheoldred , and Vorinclex all agreed to join Elesh Norn's efforts, and Atraxa was born

events.summary: Atraxa is charged with unifying the plane and makes more Phyrexian Angels, including Ixhel.
events.quote: she would go on to make more Phyrexian Angels in her visage, one of whom was Ixhel

events.summary: Elesh Norn sends Atraxa to lead the Machine Legion against New Capenna.
events.quote: Atraxa was sent by Elesh Norn to lead the efforts of the Machine Legion against the Capennans

events.summary: Atraxa corrupts the Maestros to find Phyrexian relics and rampages against their artworks.
events.quote: Atraxa corrupted the Maestros , the family most invested in the history of Capenna

events.summary: Agents of the remaining families drop Park Heights on Atraxa, killing her.
events.quote: She was later found in the rubble, a steel girder impaling her through the chest, killing her.

relations.quote: She now serves as Norn's most loyal general
Atraxa was born, shaped by Norn's own hands

relations.note: Made Ixhel as a Phyrexian angel.
relations.quote: she would go on to make more Phyrexian Angels in her visage, one of whom was Ixhel

relations.note: Mission aimed to strike a blow against her.
relations.quote: simultaneously striking a blow against Elspeth Tirel
